Von Neumann Cumulative Hierarchy Transfinite Step Generator (VonNeumannStepG)

Maps any set-sized function f to VonNeumannStepG(f) = ⋃{Y : Class | ∃(B:Class)((B ∈ Dom(f)) ∧ (Y = 𝒫(f(B))))}, generating the von Neumann cumulative hierarchy V_A = ⋃_{B ∈ A} 𝒫(V_B) via transfinite recursion on On (Entries DefVonNeumannStepGenerator (3.94) and ThmVonNeumannHierarchyByTransfiniteRecursion (3.98)).

How to Understand It

Formal Definition (DefVonNeumannStepGenerator (3.94)): Certified via def_von_neumann_step_g_cert in universe_definitions.ML. When Dom(f) = ∅, VonNeumannStepG(f) = ∅ (proved in thm_von_neumann_step_g_empty), yielding base stage V_0 = ∅, successor stage V_{A+1} = 𝒫(V_A), and limit stage V_λ = ⋃_{B ∈ λ} V_B.
